title: Run a traffic light
brief: With the Run switch on: green for 5 s, then yellow for 2 s, then red for 5 s, over and over. Only one light at a time. With Run off, all the lights are off.
hints: Use one on-delay timer (TON) for each light's time, each started by the one before it finishing.
A light is on while its own timer is running and the next one has not finished: a normally open and a normally closed contact.
To repeat, let the last timer finishing reset the first: a normally closed contact of T3.Q on the first timer's rung.

scenarios.name: Green, yellow, red in turn

assertions.says: Green should be on for the first 5 s.
Yellow should follow green, for 2 s.
Red should follow yellow, for 5 s.
After red, green should come back on.

invariants.says: Red and green must never be on together.
Red and yellow must never be on together.
Green and yellow must never be on together.

scenarios.hint: Each light is on while its own timer is running and the next one has not finished. Yellow: a normally open contact of T1.Q and a normally closed contact of T2.Q.

scenarios.name: Off turns every light off

assertions.says: With Run off, green should be off.
With Run off, yellow should be off.
With Run off, red should be off.

scenarios.hint: With Run off, the first timer resets, and the others follow. Make sure every light's rung depends on a timer, or on Run.

invariants.says: Red and green must never be on together.
Red and yellow must never be on together.
Green and yellow must never be on together.
